title: Westpac · Card details
source_note: A real customer call published by a Westpac Bank. A fake bank employee asks for credit card digits.

segments.speaker: Recipient
segments.text: Digit after eight? What does that mean?

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: Yeah, so on the credit card there that you can see beginning five, four, three, six, seven, eight.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: We need to confirm the digits after eight for cancellation.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: After that you'll be receiving a text message from us, and then that will be cancelled.

segments.speaker: Recipient
segments.text: You can't just do it straight away? Do I need to respond to the text?

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: Yep, so we'll send you the text message after we've cancelled the card for you, what we're doing now for you.
